style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. Moscow, late 1970s to 1980s, Cold War.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real agencies, hammer and sickle, red stars, flags, military or police badges, readable text or numbers, letters on license plates, blood, faces resembling real people

engineer.desc_en: the engineer, a slim middle-aged man figurine around 50 with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short dark hair streaked with gray combed back, thin black-rimmed glasses, plain brown suit jacket, white shirt, thin dark tie, carrying a plain brown leather briefcase

cia_officer.desc_en: the CIA officer, a man figurine in his 30s with a smooth featureless face, short light brown hair, plain long gray wool overcoat, dark knit scarf, no badges, no text

howard.desc_en: the fired officer, a man figurine in his 30s with a smooth featureless face, short dark brown hair, plain beige trench coat over a white shirt, no badges, no text

kgb.desc_en: the KGB men, adult man figurines with smooth featureless faces in identical plain dark gray overcoats and dark fur hats, no badges, no insignia, no red stars

cuts.en: A snowy winter street diorama in Moscow, late 1970s. A parked plain black sedan, and the engineer leaning to its slightly open window, slipping a small white envelope inside. Plain license plate with no letters. Gray overcast light.
